name: FedAvg
tagline: Plain SGD on each client + sample-count-weighted average of returned state dicts on the server.
diff_from_baseline: McMahan et al. 2017 (AISTATS). The canonical federated learning algorithm: each selected client runs local SGD for E epochs and the server takes a sample-weighted average of the resulting parameters. Default reference for any federated benchmark.

name: FedProx
tagline: FedAvg with an extra proximal term $\frac{\mu}{2}\|w-w_{\text{global}}\|^2$ added to each client's local objective.
diff_from_baseline: Li et al. 2020 (MLSys). FedAvg + per-client proximal regularizer that penalizes drift from the round's global parameters; helps non-IID clients with heterogeneous local objectives. Standard suggested $\mu \in [0.001, 0.1]$.

name: SCAFFOLD
tagline: Variance-reduced FedAvg with global and per-client control variates that correct local SGD direction.
pseudocode:
1. Server keeps global control variate $c$; each client $k$ keeps $c_k$
2. Client receives $(w^{(t)}, c)$ and runs $K$ steps of plain SGD on local data:
3.   $w \leftarrow w - \eta\,\big(\nabla \mathcal{L}_k(w; \xi) + c - c_k\big)$
4. After local training, update $c_k^+ = c_k - c + (w^{(t)} - w)/(K\eta)$ (Option II)
5. Return $w$ and $\Delta c_k = c_k^+ - c_k$ to the server
6. Server: $w^{(t+1)} = \sum_k \tfrac{n_k}{\sum n}\, w_k$ and $c \leftarrow c + \tfrac{|S_t|}{N}\,\overline{\Delta c_k}$
diff_from_baseline: Karimireddy et al. 2020 (ICML). Stochastic Controlled Averaging: server and per-client control variates correct local-SGD drift caused by client heterogeneity. Implements Algorithm 1 with the Option-II control update.
